## Specific task description

Task instruction: Ensure the dustbin the simple black garbage bin contains the plastic bottle with two distinct parts, the bottle with blue highlights, and the bottle with red screw cap.

Task description: Put the yellow-toned tall plastic bottle with distinct body sections on the left, the tall bottle with blue decoration in the middle, and the red screw-top bottle on the right into the simple black trash bin at the left edge of the table.

Success criteria: All three target bottles must enter the left bin's interior below the table while remaining some distance above the floor. Merely moving them above the opening is insufficient.

## Execution tips

- Grip the straighter parts of the bottle body on both sides below the shoulder, with the opening slightly wider than that section. Check from the side that the fingers actually surround the body; avoid gripping only the cap or the sloped shoulder, which can slip.
- When approaching the red-cap bottle, use the gap away from the small yellow bottle and blue cylinder if possible, and pre-adjust the gripper direction in an open area to avoid knocking over nearby objects while opening or turning the fingers.
- When carrying the bottle over the table and bin rims, leave enough clearance beneath its base to avoid hitting an edge and knocking the bottle out of the gripper.
- The bin opening is partly occluded and reflective in the left view. Use head and left views to confirm boundaries, placing the bottle's projection inside with rim clearance before releasing to reduce falling outside or catching on the edge.
- If bottles are already inside the bin, use remaining gaps for the next one and check after release that it is not resting on the rim or other bottles. Do not mistake a bottle suspended high above for completed storage.
